title: Mortgage Loan File Credit Report Repull Delivery Tariff
content:
Delivery of a credit report repull on a Mortgage Loan File is timed to the scheduled closing date on the file, counted in calendar days from the pull date to the scheduled closing date:

| Scheduled closing date, calendar days after the pull date | Delivery fee added |
|---|---|
| 7 or fewer | 25.00 USD (rush) |
| more than 7 but no more than 21 | 10.00 USD (expedite) |
| more than 21 | none |
| no scheduled closing date on or after the pull date | none |

**Tariff clause.** Where the scheduled closing date is 7 or fewer calendar days after the pull date, a rush fee of 25.00 USD is added; where it is more than 7 but no more than 21 calendar days after the pull date, an expedite fee of 10.00 USD is added; where it is more than 21 calendar days after the pull date, or the file has no scheduled closing date on or after the pull date, no delivery fee is added.

**Edges of each band (hypothetical pull on 1 June).**

| Scheduled closing date | Calendar days after the pull | Delivery fee |
|---|---|---|
| 8 June | 7 | 25.00 USD |
| 9 June | 8 | 10.00 USD |
| 22 June | 21 | 10.00 USD |
| 23 June | 22 | none |
| 1 June, the pull date itself | 0 | 25.00 USD |
| 31 May, before the pull date | — | none |

The scheduled closing date is the closing date currently scheduled on the file at the time of the pull.
